headline: be made up of 表示由……组成。
takeaway: of 后接组成整体的部分。
levelHint: 人教2019版高中选择性必修三 Unit 5 · 先掌握教材常用义。
studyPlan: 先听读音，结合声音与拼写对照记忆。
按义项阅读例句，比较易混表达。

forms.label: 词条基本形式

examples.en: The team is made up of five students.
The poem is made up of five lines.

collocations.en: be made up of five parts
a team made up of students
collocations.note: 过去分词短语作后置定语。

relatedExpressions.similarNote: 易混表达的区别见“近义与易混”。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: 具体关系应结合语境判断。

confusions.title: be made up of 与 consist of
confusions.summary: be made up of 和 consist of 都可表示整体由部分组成。

example.en: The team is made up of students.

confusions.takeaway: 两者可以表达相近的意思：The team is made up of students / consists of students。注意不用 is consisted of。

etymology.summary: 结合词形和用法记忆；不要根据相似字母强拆历史词根。
